Us [[Social justice warrior|Social justice warriors]] have been failing to make way in the world due to poor organization of our beliefs. This creates a hostile community that does not easily assimilate new members. Here is a codification of our values and a set of necessary reforms to make our agenda successful

== Points we will not compromise on ==

# [[Donald Trump]] and [[Trumpism]] and other forms of Putin backed populism are the enemy
# Theorists like [[Jordan Peterson]] fundamentally miss the experiences of marginalized groups and should study [[Critical theory]] more
# [[Evangelicalism]] is a fundamentally hateful movement that must be eradicated

== Agreed upon points ==

# [[Person of color|Persons of color]] are under systemic disadvantages that must be addressed at a societal level, not just an individual level
# [[LGBT]] people are unified in their needs for societal reform, and require a rethinking of narratives of gender and sexuality to gain equality
# The current economic system is fundamentally unjust
#

== Reformist points ==

# People are fundamentally incapable of educating themselves, we must build institutions to educate them and point them in the right directions
## If it's not your job to educate someone then point them to someone whose job it is
# Communities cannot police themselves. We need [[Hierarchy]] and a professional class of arbiters of disputes. [[Priest|Priests]]
#
